# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** at the workspace root for every suggestion and edit.

Repo-specific detail:

- Backend work → `Datasyncher-React-Adapter/AGENTS.md`
- Frontend work → `frontend/data-syncher-ui/AGENTS.md`

Hard requirements: reuse before inventing helpers; no secrets in source; fail-closed auth; tenant-scoped Connection lookups; frontend API calls only via `queryOptions/`; no speculative unused code.
